visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black t-shirt and grey sweatpants, stands with her hands on her hips in a suspicious posture. She is positioned behind a young man with black hair wearing a thick, multi-colored striped turtleneck sweater, who is sitting on a white textured sofa-bed looking forward with a neutral expression. (2) The woman suddenly moves forward and pulls a pinkish-beige blanket off the bed, revealing the man's lap and the bedding beneath. He remains seated and indifferent, arms crossed. (3) The woman walks around to the side of the bed, searching under the pillows while the man maintains his detached gaze. (4) As she lifts a grey pillow, a stack of blue and green banknotes is revealed scattered on the mattress. She reacts with immediate surprise, her mouth opening. (5) She grabs the money, looking towards the man with a wide, excited smile. He turns his head slightly to acknowledge her. (6) The final shot shows the two lying together under the blanket, with the woman happily holding the stack of money against her chest as the man puts his arm around her.
